text: Which organ filters blood and helps remove aged blood cells and blood-borne microbes?

Skeletal muscle
Bone marrow

A plasma-cell antibody

Bilirubin

Secreting digestive bile

Only mature red blood cells

A cell that carries oxygen
A vessel that transports lymph

A complement protein that makes pores
A type of immune-cell nucleus

choices: Engulfing all nearby bacteria
Secreting large quantities of antibody

Producing platelets in blood

It removes every cytokine from circulation

IgE
IgG4
IgA

IgA
IgE
IgG2

IgG
IgA
IgD

Osteoclasts

Producing mucus in the airway

It cannot stimulate cellular immunity
It must always be delivered through the lungs

choices: An immune response directed against the body's own components
A response directed only against pollen
The normal production of red blood cells
The transfer of antibodies across a placenta

A pathogen has acquired antibody memory
A lymph node has become a bone

An immune response that recognizes graft tissue as sufficiently foreign to attack it

choices: Cellular engulfment of particles into an internal vesicle
Antibody gene recombination in bone marrow
Release of hormones from an endocrine gland
Opening of a nuclear pore by a virus

Conserved molecular patterns associated with microbes or tissue damage

A hormone binding site on a kidney cell

Dendritic cell

Mitochondrial fission
V(D)J recombination
